subject: general
question: The mean of a set of 120 observations is 80. 10 is subtracted from each observation and each of the corresponding result is divided by 7. What is the mean of the new set?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Arithmetic Mean** follows the same linear transformations as the individual observations.

Initial **Mean** = 80

Step 1 (Subtraction): 80 − 10 = 70

Step 2 (Division): 70 ÷ 7 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of **observations** (n) = 120

Original **Mean** (µₒₗd) = 80

**Formula Used:**

If each observation xᵢ is transformed to yᵢ = (xᵢ − a) ÷ b, then New Mean (µₙₑw) = (µₒₗd − a) ÷ b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/507c63d038b9653c1efdb58472edcc76a0fc31dd1f6affad09fd2f2f08c935e5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of original 120 observations (∑xᵢ) = 120 × 80 = 9600

⇒ New observations result from subtracting 10: ∑(xᵢ − 10) = 9600 − (120 × 10) = 9600 − 1200 = 8400

⇒ Each result is then divided by 7: ∑[(xᵢ − 10) ÷ 7] = 8400 ÷ 7 = 1200

⇒ **New Mean** = New Total Sum ÷ Number of observations

⇒ **New Mean** = 1200 ÷ 120 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Change of Origin

If a constant k is added to or subtracted from every value in a dataset, the **mean** increases or decreases by the same constant k.

Change of Scale

If every value in a dataset is multiplied or divided by a non-zero constant k, the **mean** is also multiplied or divided by k.

Combined Mean Formula

For two sets with means x₁ and x₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂, the combined mean is (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p
